injuries.name: Trey Murphy III
injuries.note: Murphy (knee) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.note: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.note: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Scottie Barnes
injuries.note: Barnes (groin) is out for Thursday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.note: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Evan Mobley
injuries.note: Mobley (toe) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.note: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.note: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL.

injuries.name: Stephen Curry
injuries.note: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.note: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.note: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.note: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.note: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.note: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

injuries.name: Dejounte Murray
injuries.note: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.note: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Chicago.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.note: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season.

injuries.name: Sam Merrill
injuries.note: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.note: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

injuries.name: Pelle Larsson
injuries.note: Larsson (illness) is out for Friday's game against Cleveland.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.note: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

injuries.name: Zach Edey
injuries.note: Edey won't play in Friday's game against the Pelicans due to left ankle injury management.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.note: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March.

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.note: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.note: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Precious Achiuwa
injuries.note: Achiuwa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Trail Blazers.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.note: Barlow (back) participated in Thursday's shootaround but doesn't have a timeline to return to game action.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.note: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.note: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Williams
injuries.note: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.note: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months.

injuries.name: Klay Thompson
injuries.note: Thompson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.note: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.note: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries.note: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.note: Pippen (back) remains out for Wednesday's game against Denver.

injuries.name: Bryce McGowens
injuries.note: McGowens (elbow) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.note: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.note: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months.

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.note: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.note: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland and remains out indefinitely.

injuries.name: Keshon Gilbert
injuries.note: Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.note: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom.

injuries.name: Adem Bona
injuries.note: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist.

injuries.name: Quinten Post
injuries.note: Post (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against New Orleans.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.note: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

injuries.name: Trendon Watford
injuries.note: Watford (ankle) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
injuries.note: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.note: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.note: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.note: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.note: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday.

injuries.name: Clint Capela
injuries.note: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.note: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.note: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.note: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.note: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.note: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.note: Youngblood (foot) is out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.note: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Dailyn Swain
injuries.note: Swain (back) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Tobe Awaka

injuries.name: Caleb Wilson
injuries.note: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.note: Biberovic (heel) is out for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.note: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game at Minnesota.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.note: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.note: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.note: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.note: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.note: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.note: Bittle (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.note: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Luka Doncic
injuries.note: Head coach JJ Redick said Friday that Doncic (ankle) is "fine,".

injuries.name: Austin Reaves
injuries.note: Reaves (heel) won't undergo imaging and is considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: LeBron James

injuries.name: De'Aaron Fox

injuries.name: Paul George

injuries.name: Devin Vassell

injuries.name: Brandon Miller

injuries.name: Quentin Grimes

injuries.name: Max Christie

injuries.name: Marcus Smart

injuries.name: Bub Carrington

injuries.name: Ajay Mitchell

injuries.name: Collin Sexton

injuries.name: Nolan Traore

injuries.name: Charles Bassey

injuries.name: Trayce Jackson-Davis

Acquired draft considerations from Cleveland Guardians for G Peyton Watson.

Acquired F Santi Aldama from Memphis. Acquired G Marcus Sasser from Detroit.
Acquired G Jaden Hardy from Washington in exchange for draft considerations.
Acquired draft considerations from Atlanta Hawks for G Aaron Wiggins.
Signed G Anfernee Simons and F Dean Wade to contracts. Acquired G Jaylen Brown from the Boston Celtics. Signed C Ariel Hukporti to a contract.

Re-signed F Andrew Wiggins to a veteran extension. Acquired Fs Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis from the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Gs Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr. and Kasparas Jakucionis, C Kel'el Ware and draft considerations. Signed G Tim Hardaway Jr. to a contract.
